title: Start the agent at boot, before login
summary: The Cobra agent is a systemd user service.
systemd starts user services at boot only when lingering is on for your user.
Turn on lingering to start the agent before you log in [1].

sentences: A user service runs in your user manager, not in the system manager.
The user manager starts when you log in and stops when your last session closes [2].
With lingering on, the user manager starts at boot and continues after you log out [1].
Then the agent starts at boot, and your phone can connect to it before you log in.
The agent installer tells you about this when lingering is off [3].

procedure.text: Open a terminal on the Laptop.

procedure.result: No output shows. This is correct.

sentences: Do not restart the Laptop while a Claude session runs in the agent.
If you restart it, the session stops and you can lose work that you did not save.

procedure.text: Before you log in, open Fleet in Cobra on your phone.
procedure.result: The Laptop shows online in less than 1 minute.
note: You do this procedure one time for each computer.
The change stays after you restart.
